mono-readout.purpose: seq/pid/cost/token figures and the terminal grid; monospace is semantic.

motion.name: draft-tick
motion.purpose: One tick a second while a turn is in flight; labels print whole seconds.

motion.name: delta-coalesce
motion.purpose: Answer deltas flush on a timer instead of restating the bubble per token.

components.name: Send Disc

components.description: Full-round label that opens a sheet (model picker).

narrative.overview: AIxodia is a control surface for one technical operator, and it looks like the tools that operator already trusts at 2am: a pure-black page, every raised surface the same navy taken to increasing strength, and a single soft sky-blue accent that marks what is interactive or alive. Depth is tonal, never cast — no shadow is drawn anywhere. Density and precision are the identity: Discord's drawer, Telegram's bubbles, a terminal's monospace readouts.
keyCharacteristics: Pure black page; navy-only tonal ramp for all elevation.
One accent (#7FB2FF) for interactive/alive; status colours are reserved roles.
48dp circular discs and full-round pills as the composer's only button silhouettes.
Hairline borders do the separating; shadows do nothing.

rules.name: The Reserved-Signal Rule
rules.body: Green, amber and red mean online/connecting/offline and nothing else. A brand element may never borrow them.

rules.name: The One-Voice Rule
rules.body: Sky Accent marks the living thing on screen. If an element is neither interactive nor alive, it wears the navy ramp.

rules.name: The Readout Floor Rule
rules.body: No rendered text below 11sp; anything carrying information a glance must catch is >=12sp.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Tone Rule
rules.body: Elevation = brightness within one hue. If you reach for a shadow, you want the next navy step up.

dos: Do express elevation as the next navy step up (surfaceContainer*), separated by the hairline #2A3544 when two darks meet.
Do keep machine readouts monospace and >=12sp.
Do reserve green/amber/red for connection state and the send blue for the send disc.
Do give raw touch surfaces the 48dp floor and a Role.Button semantic.
Do let the user retune the accent and base radius; everything else stays structural.
donts: Don't draw shadows, gradients, or glows; the console is flat by tone.
Don't introduce a second palette in the UI layer - non-role colours live in AixodiaColors beside the scheme.
Don't put the terminal's ink chrome under theme control; a shell renders the shell's colours.
Don't ship iOS-shaped components or hijack system Back.
Don't drop any label below 11sp to save a line.
